name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Context Menu: a case that opens at the pointer (no notch), popping in. Rows invert to ink on hover or keyboard focus; checkbox rows get a brush check, radio rows an ink diamond; destructive rows use the accent; sub-menus have a brush chevron. Rows are 44px tall under 640 px. Put ContextMenuLabel inside a ContextMenuGroup: Base UI requires it (Radix does not). Works with Base UI and Radix.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/context-menu". It wraps your own components/ui/context-menu, so Radix and Base UI both work. ContextMenuTwin and ContextMenuTwinRow are static look-alikes for documentation and state grids.

meta.tagline: A case that opens at the pointer; the row under it turns to ink.
meta.usage:
import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/context-menu"

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger>Right-click this page</ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuItem>Bookmark</ContextMenuItem>
    <ContextMenuItem variant="destructive">Delete</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>

props.name: ContextMenuTwin
props.description: A static look-alike of an open menu, for documentation and state grids. Takes className and children.

props.name: ContextMenuTwinRow
props.description: One row of the static menu. Takes the booleans highlighted, checked, radio, disabled, destructive and sub.
